origin.description: Raises a real symmetric matrix to a real power from its eigenvalues.

arguments.name: m
arguments.text: A real symmetric matrix. Only the lower triangle is used.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Absolute eigenvalues at or below tol are set to zero.

origin.details: A matrix that is not symmetric within 100 machine epsilons raises an error. A negative power of a negative eigenvalue is NaN, matching R. Zero to a negative power is infinity, and zero to the power zero is 1.
origin.value: A matrix of the same shape.
